text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The loud cheers echoing from the stands, and your shout, which was just as loud...
are still ringing in my ears.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Even though they had such high hopes for me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Next time... I want to answer those cheers.
I want to gift them a victory...!"
choice_data_list: Let's turn these expectations into strength.
Then it's time for special training for the next one!
Then let's do some special training for the next one!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Next time... I want to answer those cheers.
I want to gift them a victory...!"
choice_data_list: Let's turn these expectations into strength.
Then it's time for special training for the next one!
Then let's do some special training for the next one!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Turn expectations into strength... Yeah, that's right...!
choice_data_list: If it's you, you can do it, right?
If it's you, you can do it, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's cheers give me strength.
They make me want to keep running harder.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: It's always... been like that, after all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
We're both reliable to each other.
Let's keep doing our best in training, okay?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
And next time, I'll definitely take 1st place.
I'll win and show everyone my gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
How to conserve stamina, the timing of the final spurt...
There's still plenty of room for growth.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I need to put in even more training.
choice_data_list: I'll redo the menu right away!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Reliable as always.
Or maybe composed is the word?
choice_data_list: I don't think that's quite right.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: I just want to win, with Buena.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I want to win with you, too.
Let's go see the view of victory... together!
